mechanism: Erythromycin is a CYP3A4 inhibitor that may increase dolutegravir plasma concentrations, though dolutegravir is primarily metabolized by UGT1A1 with minor CYP3A4 involvement.
action: Monitor dolutegravir efficacy and tolerability; consider alternative macrolide (azithromycin) if prolonged therapy needed, as the interaction is generally manageable with standard dosing.
